whyText: Partner’s family is in Munich; I want to hold my own at dinner.
experienceText: Two Duolingo streaks that died; I can order food.

approach.approachNotes: You learn a language by understanding messages and being pushed to produce them. We’ll pair short comprehensible input — reading and listening slightly above your level — with small speaking and writing reps every session, so recognition turns into production.
pitfalls: App streaks that reward recognition without production
Grammar-first study that stalls real conversation
Input that is too hard, which quietly kills motivation
progressionPrinciples: High-frequency conversational chunks before grammar rules
Comprehensible input at i+1, always paired with output
Recycle vocabulary across contexts rather than word lists
